BiblicalUsage: Chom is heat, the warmth of the sun at its strongest, and it marks the turning of the day and the year. The sun is hot by the time the men of Jabesh are delivered, Ish-bosheth is murdered in the heat of the day, God promises that cold and heat shall not cease while the earth remains, and Haggai says the people clothe themselves but there is none warm.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe heat in these verses is the measure of a day, whether it brings deliverance or murder. I hold that God's promise of seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, is the ground of every farmer's hope.
